title: منظومة قواعد الأفضل — 20 قاعدة كونية من الكتاب والسنة + تفعيل الكل
reason: The PR contains important rules and foundation logic, but also touches server.js, package files, and duplicated dist outputs. Only reviewed source changes may be merged.

doNotMergeReasons.dist/: Generated outputs are not authoritative source.
doNotMergeReasons.server.js: Large boot/runtime change requires separate focused patch review.

doNotMergeReasons.package-lock.json: Dependency lock changes include major version shifts and older Google storage stack.
